description: Manual acceptance coverage map for the maintained Playwright E2E gate. Each entry links a canonical acceptance flow to automated coverage, intentional manual coverage, or a deferred issue.

The default packaged workflow proves nativeMessaging, the live-local Chromium probe, pairing-import artifacts, Queue and Gallery controls, and the interop runtime registry are absent. The same spec retains an explicit IMAGE_TRAIL_ENABLE_INTEROP=1 path that runs the injected Native Messaging/WebSocket service-worker probe through redemption, reviewed open, ciphertext acknowledgement, progress, heartbeat, and close without exposing capability data to page messaging, then proves the experimental Queue workflow defaults to Local, describes cloud as an explicit no-fallback route, preserves row selection and queue order, and hands pairing off to the secure extension page; existing workflows guard selected export, Gallery, and detached-panel behavior.

coverage.reason: Provider credentials and the signed iCloud host remain owner-run closeout evidence in issue #590 before the experimental gate can be removed.
coverage.notes: Build with IMAGE_TRAIL_ENABLE_INTEROP=1, then open Transfer and Sync from one Queue row, a multi-selection, Gallery, and a captured original. Verify Local is selected first; pairing remains separate from presence; missing host, closed app, locked app, incompatible app, connecting, connected, interrupted, and resumable states are exact; cloud is chosen only explicitly; and an active journal cannot change routes until completion or cancellation. With signed Overlook running and paired, verify the released Image Trail identity alone can obtain a one-use capability, the connection uses only the exact 127.0.0.1 session endpoint, sleep or worker restart pauses safely and requires fresh bootstrap, cancellation remains retryable, and no token, plaintext, filename, or ciphertext appears in host-page DOM, content messages, logs, or durable extension storage. Authorize pCloud once, allow the OAuth window to remain open long enough for the original message channel to close, and return focus; verify the connected state refreshes without another OAuth window and repeated Connect clicks never queue windows. Deny or invalidate the app-folder scope and verify an honest provider-unavailable message with Retry check instead of a Reconnect loop. Also verify exact counts and recovery copy, keyboard containment, narrow layout, preserved selection and queue order, and no thumbnails, names, counts, or provider details in the locked workspace. In a production build with the closed panel Shadow DOM, click Transfer & Sync in the in-page panel and verify the workflow dialog opens inside the panel while document.body gains no image-trail-interop-scrim node.
